people.name: Donald Trump

issues.midterm_loss: First said he wasn't on the ballot and blamed weak candidates and Fox News; by Nov 8 (60 Minutes) blamed the war, dislike of Israel, bad economic messaging and a deportation policy that "might be too tough." Nov 19 (Truth Social, self-started): posted a graphic of past presidents' midterm losses that undercounted the GOP's Senate and House losses (Daily Beast, Nov 20). Nov 23 (CNBC Squawk on the Street, prompted): "I wasn't on the ballot. I think if I was, it would have been a whole different story"; said Democrats "have caused us to lose 5 trillion" in market value.
issues.trump: Doubled down: named Stephen Miller chief of staff (Nov 6), said he'll keep Hegseth, displayed a VETO hat, staying out of House leader race. Called Vance's diagnosis largely true. Nov 8: Vance's comments didn't hurt their relationship, but "a lot of people didn't like his comments. But not me." Nov 18 (Fox): said Vance is "doing a very good job" but "left one thing out: If we had it to do again, would you do it again?" (Daily Beast, Nov 18).
issues.tariffs: Nov 23 (CNBC): "We lost our chip business because we had presidents that didn't understand the word tariff."
issues.healthcare: Nov 20 press conference: said the new Democratic majority could work with Republicans on healthcare, 'a combination of what we all want,' and 'we could end up with great healthcare'; no plan named (Common Dreams, Nov 20). Nov 21: reposted El-Sayed's 'TrumpCare' Medicare for All card on Truth Social without comment (RedState, Politico, Nov 21-22).
issues.immigration: Nov 8 (60 Minutes): said his deportation policy "might be too tough" and was part of why Republicans lost; said a deal with the Democratic majority is doable; would still deport killers and drug dealers but was open to letting working, in some cases taxpaying, "good people" stay. No specifics. Nov 9, the day after 60 Minutes, told reporters "There's no amnesty" and "my policy hasn't changed," while still praising undocumented workers who pay taxes (Fox News, Nov 9). Nov 20: dodged a question on legalization ("the worst of the worst"); Nov 22 Truth Social: "OPEN BORDERS DESTROY NATIONS!" (Breitbart, Nov 22).
issues.iran_war: Conceded the war and higher gas prices hurt, but gave an "emphatic yes" when asked if he'd do it again. Nov 19: reposted Laura Loomer's 'I for one voted for blowing up Islamic terrorists' on Truth Social (Daily Beast, Nov 20). Nov 18 (Fox): claimed without evidence Iran is "looking at gases, looking at bio" and "we wipe them out" if so; Nov 19 (Channel 12): "not rushing" a decision; Nov 21 (Fox): wants a "permanent" deal (CBS News live updates, Nov 20-22). Nov 22 (Truth Social): Iran has launched more drones and missiles in the last week than at any time in over a year; Iran's leaders think Democrats are weak, 'but I won't let that happen!' (CBS News live updates, Nov 22).
issues.ai: Nov 23: pressed Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO ("I convinced them. I made the deal," ABC News); called it the "correct and proper decision" on Truth Social; told CNBC he'd have "loved" a government stake in Nvidia "but I don't want to get sued."
issues.israel: Election Day (Fox & Friends): said the ~$4B in annual military aid ends this year. Nov 8 (60 Minutes): said a "great dislike" of Israel contributed to the losses.

people.other_themes: Called Massie a "low life"; blamed Democrats for the post-election stock drop. Nov 9: called the Iran war "militarily … effectively over" and suggested without evidence that voting machines were to blame. Endorsed RNC chair Gruters for another term (Nov 6). Nov 21 press conference called Schumer and Jeffries 'smart' ('If they want to get things done, I want to get things done too'); Nov 22 Truth Social: 'very hard for me to work with Chuck Schumer' as leader (Newsweek, Nov 22)
people.sources: Truth Social posts and press remarks, Nov 4–8; CBS 60 Minutes, Nov 8; Times of Israel, Nov 4; The Hill via The National Desk, Nov 8–11; pbs.org, Nov 9; Daily Beast via Yahoo, Nov 20 (https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-spirals-truth-social-way-020627908.html); Common Dreams, Nov 20 (https://www.commondreams.org/news/donald-trump-healthcare-plan); RedState, Nov 21 (https://redstate.com/beccalower/2026/11/21/popcorn-trump-trolls-abdul-el-sayed-over-offer-to-name-medicare-for-all-bill-after-him-n2209665); Newsweek, Nov 22 (https://www.newsweek.com/trump-targets-schumer-as-van-hollen-challenges-him-for-senate-leadership-12753718); Fox News, Nov 9 (https://www.foxnews.com/politics/white-house-doubles-down-trump-angers-base-floating-illegal-alien-deal-dems.amp); Breitbart, Nov 22 (https://www.breitbart.com/politics/2026/11/22/trump-says-he-saved-usa-from-open-borders-that-destroy-nations/); CBS News, Nov 20-22 (https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-tehran-denies-chemical-weapons/); Daily Beast, Nov 18 (https://www.thedailybeast.com/trump-throws-jd-vance-under-the-bus-as-bitter-feud-over-iran-war-heats-up); CBS News, Nov 22 (https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-tehran-denies-chemical-weapons/); CNBC transcript, Nov 23 (https://pressroom.versantmedia.com/cnbc/press-releases/cnbc-transcript-president-donald-trump-speaks-cnbcs-eamon-javers-and-squawk); ABC News, Nov 23 (https://abcnews.com/Politics/republicans-condemn-jensen-huangs-reinstatement-nvidia-after-trump/story?id=138384161); Manila Times, Nov 24 (https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/24/world/vance-tapped-as-trumps-emissary-to-nvidia-board-amid-ceo-reinstatement-concerns/2476614)

trump_alignment.note: Defines the axis (+2). Doubling down on personnel (Miller, Hegseth) and on the war.

economic.note: Far populist: tariffs and industrial policy are his signature. No change.

israel.stance: Pro-Israel, now hedging: announced the end of aid and named dislike of Israel as a cause of the loss.

people.name: JD Vance

issues.midterm_loss: Nov 4 X post: "The reason we lost is the war." Said 2024 Trump/Vance voters switched to Democrats; not a turnout problem. Nov 16 (Fox): "We got shellacked," and "Voters want gas prices low. That's a lot of why we lost"; blamed "neoconservatives" who want to stay in Iran "forever" (Newsweek, Nov 17).
issues.trump: No direct criticism of Trump, but blamed the signature policy of his second term.
issues.tariffs: Listed cost of living as one of four reasons voters defected.
issues.immigration: Listed "America First" drift as a defection reason.
issues.iran_war: Named the war as the main cause; wants it ended.
issues.israel: Listed "change our relationship to Israel" as one of four reasons Trump voters defected. Drew fire from CUFI, Rep. Randy Fine and others; his spokesperson said he did not blame Jews.

people.other_themes: Don Jr. endorsed the post; Axios read it as a 2028 pitch to MAGA's anti-interventionist wing.
people.sources: Vance X post, Nov 4; JNS; Axios, Nov 5; JTA, Nov 6; Newsweek, Nov 17 (https://newsweek.com/jd-vance-slams-neoconservatives-over-iran-forever-war-12724399)

trump_alignment.note: Was the heir (+2). Now blames Trump's war while sparing Trump personally, so he moves to Distancer (−1).

economic.note: Populist: pro-tariff, pro-worker America First economics; led with cost of living. No change.

israel.stance: Skeptic/realist: wants a "normal relationship with a normal country"; post-election made it a stated reason for the loss.

walkbacks.said: In his first TV interview since the midterms (Fox News, Laura Ingraham) said 'There's no daylight' between him and Trump on the Iran war. Didn't retract that the war cost Republicans; said it carried 'a political cost' and Trump won't let it become a 'forever war.'

Asked at a White House press conference to square backing the war with his Nov 4 post blaming it for the loss, said "My job is to support the president of the United States"; didn't retract that the war cost the party.

people.name: Marco Rubio

issues.midterm_loss: Nov 5 (NYT): conceded higher gas prices hurt but said Trump deserves credit for the war and called the political cost "the price of leadership." Nov 9 (Paris, G7): said the losses won't change foreign policy, which the president sets.
issues.trump: Defended Trump's Iran decision days after the loss; Trump praised him and floated a Vance-Rubio ticket. Separate reports say he is weighing leaving for a 2028 run (White House denies).
issues.iran_war: Nov 5 (NYT): said Trump deserves a tremendous amount of credit for the war despite its cost at the polls. Defended the war at the CPAC gala at Mar-a-Lago (Nov 6): Trump wasn't elected to let threats linger. Nov 8: said talks with Iran are not near a breakthrough and called Iran's demands unacceptable. Reportedly favors tighter sanctions over Vance-style diplomacy. Nov 10 (G7, Paris): "really no need for major combat operations any longer" because the blockade and sanctions are working (Jewish Insider, Nov 10).
issues.israel: Pre-election: the administration's leading Iran hawk; pro-Israel donors see him as the alternative to Vance.

people.other_themes: Some pro-Israel donors and Rep. Randy Fine prefer him to Vance for 2028. Nov 5: said he will no longer talk about 2028 at all.
people.sources: JFeed/CPAC remarks, Nov 6; Daily Wire; The Independent; Bloomberg; theweek.in, Nov 10; townhall.com, Nov 6; Jewish Insider, Nov 10 (https://jewishinsider.com/2026/11/marco-rubio-iran-military-operations-unnecessary-negotiations/)

trump_alignment.note: Stayed loyal (+2): defended the war days after the loss. The one hopeful moving with Trump, not away.

economic.note: Moderately populist from his Senate industrial-policy record; silent on economics. No change.

israel.stance: Strong pro-Israel hawk; the donor class's Vance alternative.

people.name: Josh Hawley

issues.midterm_loss: Said a defeat of this magnitude "demands change"; blamed abandoning pro-lifers and working people.
issues.trump: Aimed at Senate leadership, not Trump; declined to commit to re-electing Thune (Nov 9). Nov 10: said he'd vote to delay the leadership election, hadn't heard from Thune, and wants "a different direction."
issues.tariffs: Cited fertilizer and gas costs (not tariffs by name).
issues.healthcare: Said healthcare costs are "through the roof"; attacked Medicaid and rural-hospital cuts. Nov 11 (X): listed funding rural hospitals among lame-duck priorities.
issues.iran_war: Nov 11 (Jewish Insider): called the war "an issue" in the loss but not the only one. Nov 19: told USA Today "It's time to bring the war to a close," then voted no on H.Con.Res. 93 (rejected 48-51), arguing the operation isn't "hostilities" under the War Powers Act; said he could back cutting off funds for offensive operations. Matches his September vote, so not a walkback.
issues.ai: Attacked funding data centers while cutting Medicaid. Nov 11 (X): put a national moratorium on data center construction on his to-do list for Senate Republicans' last six weeks in the majority.
issues.israel: Nov 11 (Jewish Insider): declined to endorse Vance's Israel diagnosis, saying he'd let the vice president speak for himself and wasn't sure what he meant.

people.other_themes: Pro-life base; Planned Parenthood funding; leadership revolt. Nov 11 (X) lame-duck agenda: defund Planned Parenthood, suspend the gas tax, fund rural hospitals, pass the SAVE America Act, and a national data center moratorium. Nov 10: said losing at least seven Senate seats means the party must change course.
people.sources: Hawley remarks, Nov 9; The Hill, Nov 9; Axios and CBS News, Nov 10; jewishinsider.com, Nov 11; townhall.com, Nov 11; U.S. Senate roll call 269, Nov 19 (https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS/roll_call_votes/vote1192/vote_119_2_00269.htm)

trump_alignment.note: Started semi-independent (+1); now aims at leadership rather than Trump. Distancer (−1).

economic.note: Far populist: attacks corporate subsidies and data centers and defends Medicaid. Holding, louder.

israel.stance: Pro-Israel on record; post-election declined to back or reject Vance's call to change the relationship.

people.name: Ron DeSantis

issues.midterm_loss: Called it "close to an extinction-level event"; GOP not viable nationally without TX/KS/IA.
issues.trump: Nov 4 (Fox, Ingraham): called the result a rebuke of both the president and Congress, on "both sides of Pennsylvania Avenue," though most of his fire went at Senate GOP inaction (filibuster, immigration, court jurisdiction).
issues.healthcare: Nov 22 (X, self-started): called Peggy Flanagan's 'TrumpCare'/Medicare for All pitch on CNN "political malpractice."
issues.immigration: Asked why the Senate hasn't shut off H-1B visas or codified Trump's immigration orders; criticized Ramaswamy on foreign-worker visas; wary of street conflict from federal operations.
issues.iran_war: Pre-window baseline (Nov 2, SiriusXM): gas is higher "because of this conflict"; ignoring the war's cost is "gaslighting" voters. No post-election war remark found.
issues.ai: Warned about technology and privacy concerns.
issues.corruption: Slammed Republicans who voted against releasing the Epstein files.
issues.israel: Pre-election: long record as a strongly pro-Israel governor.

people.other_themes: "No saviors"; urged Senate to confirm judges in the lame duck. Nov 15 (X), on GOP senators resisting Trump's lame-duck judges: "Ugh. And Republicans wonder why they have problems with base voter enthusiasm."
people.sources: Florida news conference and Fox News (Ingraham), Nov 4 (via AOL/Mediaite, Nov 6); other remarks; Raw Story, Nov 15 (https://www.rawstory.com/trump-judges-2678412367/); The National Desk via ABC News 4, Nov 3 (https://abcnews4.com/news/nation-world/florida-gov-ron-desantis-says-the-iran-war-has-backfired-on-republicans-donald-trump-2024-gop); Wisevoter, Nov 23 (https://wisevoter.com/world/us/2026/11/23/desantis-flanagan-clash-over-health-insurance)

trump_alignment.note: Started semi-independent (+1); called the loss a rebuke of the president and Congress, aiming mostly at Senate GOP inaction. Distancer (−1).

economic.note: Was center (0); H-1B cuts, a stock-trading ban and tech-privacy worries push him populist (+1).

israel.stance: Strongly pro-Israel on record; silent on Vance's post.

people.name: Ted Budd

issues.midterm_loss: Co-signed the Nov 9 letter calling the result "a stunning defeat" with "multiple reasons" and demanding "serious discussions" on improving the outcome in 2028; said electing leaders first would be "political malpractice." Wanted candidates to lay out a "collaborative conference governing model" and a strategy "to counter the emboldened Democrats."
issues.iran_war: Nov 19: voted no on H.Con.Res. 93, the Iran war powers resolution (Senate roll call 269, rejected 48-51).
issues.israel: Nov 11 (Jewish Insider): asked what Vance meant by changing the relationship; called Israel the region's only democracy and a longtime ally; said the partnership's nature will change but the U.S. must keep Israel as an ally.

people.other_themes: Whatley lost the NC Senate race to Cooper. The delay push failed Nov 10; the conference voted to proceed and re-elected Thune.
people.sources: Fox News Digital and The Hill, Nov 9–10; AP and CBS News, Nov 10; co-signed letter to Chairman Cotton, Nov 9; jewishinsider.com, Nov 11; U.S. Senate roll call 269, Nov 19 (https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS/roll_call_votes/vote1192/vote_119_2_00269.htm)

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2) before; signing the debrief-first letter is a mild break with leadership. Hedger (+1).

israel.stance: Pro-Israel: pushed back on Vance and wants Israel kept as a close ally, while conceding the partnership will change.

people.name: Jim Jordan
people.role: U.S. Rep. (OH); elected House GOP leader for the next Congress (Nov 10)

issues.midterm_loss: Leadership letter (Nov 4): "a staggering day for our Conference"; "offense, not defense, wins elections." Casting himself as the change candidate (Axios, Nov 10). Won the House GOP leader race over Scalise, 106–73 (Nov 10); said Republicans "will fight for American families."
issues.trump: Pitches himself as battle-tested on oversight; running against Scalise.

people.sources: Jordan leadership letter, Nov 4; Axios, Nov 10; CBS News, Nov 10; CNN, Nov 11; townhall.com, Nov 14

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2) and pitching offense over introspection. Holds.

economic.note: Conventional; economics secondary to oversight fights.

people.name: Tate Reeves

issues.midterm_loss: Called it a difficult environment for Republicans.

people.other_themes: Confident Hyde-Smith holds the uncalled MS Senate seat.
people.sources: Reeves remarks (news coverage)

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); concedes a tough environment without blaming Trump. Hedger (+1).

people.name: Stephen Miller
people.role: White House chief of staff (since Nov 9)

issues.midterm_loss: X post: "Fight with all of our soul to support our President."
issues.trump: Promotion over Wiles read as Trump doubling down.

people.sources: Miller X post, Nov 6; ksat.com, Nov 15

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2). Now running the White House, so he is the baseline.

economic.note: Economic nationalism through an immigration and labor lens.

people.name: Pete Hegseth

issues.trump: Celebrated Miller's promotion.
issues.iran_war: Defended the war as courageous and historic; "we don't back down."
issues.corruption: Called the impeachment push a sham; called Massie disgruntled and defeated.
issues.israel: Pre-election: strongly pro-Israel; ran the joint U.S.-Israel campaign against Iran.

people.other_themes: Faces Massie's impeachment articles. On Nov 10 declined to say whether he agrees with Vance that the war cost Republicans the midterms. Called Massie's impeachment push a "political spectacle" and a "farce" as the House killed it, 211–204 (Nov 10).
people.sources: Hegseth posts/remarks, Nov 5–8 (news coverage); CBS News, Nov 10

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); defends the war outright.

economic.note: Not an economic actor; scored neutral.

israel.stance: Strongly pro-Israel; ran the joint campaign.

people.name: Byron Donalds

issues.midterm_loss: Said voter frustration over gas and diesel prices boiled over.
issues.trump: Thanked Trump.

people.other_themes: Plans to focus on affordability, housing and insurance.
people.sources: Donalds remarks (news coverage)

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); acknowledges fuel-price anger and thanks Trump. Hedger (+1).

economic.note: Conventional; affordability focus (housing, insurance) with no new direction.

people.name: Joe Gruters
people.role: RNC chair; Trump-backed for new term vs. KC Crosbie (Jan.)

issues.midterm_loss: No public diagnosis of the loss found. On Election Day he predicted Republicans would "surprise a lot of people." In a letter to members (Thursday, apparently Nov 12), acknowledged their concerns and pledged to "listen and learn," and held private calls with members; his allies rejected Crosbie's call for a post-election review.
issues.trump: Trump endorsed him for another term.

people.other_themes: RNC co-chair KC Crosbie announced a challenge (Nov 5 letter), calling the midterms a serious setback and urging an honest account. Gruters defended RNC spending her backers question: donor hospitality at the Presidents Cup, a contract for Susie Wiles's daughter (hired by Whatley, he said) and hair and makeup for White House officials. Some members want a forensic audit. Chair vote is in January in Arizona.
people.sources: Breitbart, Nov 3; Washington Examiner and Just the News, Nov 6–8; ksat.com, Nov 15

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); Trump-endorsed for another term. Silent.

people.name: Jeff Landry

issues.midterm_loss: X post (Nov 5): called Louisiana's Senate hold and a failed recall drive a "bright spot" amid national losses; said voters want conservative leadership.

people.other_themes: Letlow narrowly held the LA Senate seat.
people.sources: Louisiana Illuminator via Yahoo News, Nov 6

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); acknowledged the national losses without assigning blame. Hedger (+1).

people.name: Sarah Huckabee Sanders

issues.midterm_loss: Said the economy was the leading factor. Nov 15 (CNN State of the Union): said there's no question Election Night was a bad night for Republicans.
issues.trump: Defended Trump: his name wasn't on the ballot. Called Vance the 2028 frontrunner.
issues.iran_war: Said she's thankful for Trump's Iran decision.
issues.israel: Pre-election: strongly pro-Israel record (her father is U.S. ambassador to Israel and rejected Vance's claim).

people.other_themes: Nov 15 (CNN): didn't rule out a future presidential run; said she loves being governor, is focused on Arkansas and is term-limited in four years.
people.sources: Sanders remarks (news coverage); cnn.com, Nov 15; dailywire.com, Nov 15

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); defends Trump and the Iran decision.

economic.note: Conventional; blames the economy but defends policy.

people.name: Eric Schmitt

issues.midterm_loss: No comment on the losses found (Nov 3–10).
issues.iran_war: Nov 19: voted no on H.Con.Res. 93, the Iran war powers resolution (Senate roll call 269, rejected 48-51).

people.other_themes: Nov 6: called Democrats' plans to probe the Supreme Court "retribution and lawfare" and said Democrats "don't care about lowering prices".
people.sources: Daily Signal, Nov 6; U.S. Senate roll call 269, Nov 19 (https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS/roll_call_votes/vote1192/vote_119_2_00269.htm)

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); silent.

issues.trump: No criticism of Trump; wants to pass as much of the agenda as possible before January.
issues.iran_war: Nov 19: voted no on H.Con.Res. 93, the Iran war powers resolution (Senate roll call 269, rejected 48-51).

people.other_themes: Husted lost the other OH seat to Sherrod Brown; Ramaswamy lost governor.
people.sources: Washington Sun, Nov 5; Fox News Digital, Nov 9; U.S. Senate roll call 269, Nov 19 (https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS/roll_call_votes/vote1192/vote_119_2_00269.htm); Roll Call, Nov 10 (https://www.rollcall.com/2026/11/10/bernie-moreno-brian-jack-republicans-2028); Roll Call, Nov 10; IBTimes UK citing Politico, Nov 18 (https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/bernie-moreno-republicans-2028-senate-map-1833220)

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); conceded the loss and pivoted to a lame-duck sprint, no diagnosis. Hedger (+1).

people.name: Jim Banks

issues.midterm_loss: "There's no way to spin it" (WIBC, Nov 6): a bad night; voters sent a message on gas, grocery and housing costs; Democrats "outworked us" and turnout hurt. Nov 9: "tomorrow is too soon" for leadership elections; wants a frank talk about "where we fell short."
issues.immigration: Pre-election: pushed an H-1B and immigration-codification package.
issues.iran_war: Nov 19: voted no on H.Con.Res. 93, the Iran war powers resolution (Senate roll call 269, rejected 48-51).
issues.ai: Nov 15 (Fox News Sunday): in the Nvidia chip-smuggling scandal, faulted Commerce Secretary Lutnick for not closing export loopholes or blacklisting Megaspeed despite espionage warnings; wants Lutnick to testify even more than Jensen Huang. Said Trump has been clear on chips to China.

people.sources: WIBC, Nov 6; WOWO, Nov 4; statement reported by Bloomberg and Fox News, Nov 9; 21alivenews.com, Nov 15; U.S. Senate roll call 269, Nov 19 (https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS/roll_call_votes/vote1192/vote_119_2_00269.htm)

trump_alignment.note: Loyal (+2); blamed prices and party execution, not Trump, and backed delaying leadership votes. Hedger (+1).

economic.note: Populist-leaning on visas and labor; silent.

people.name: Tom Cotton

issues.midterm_loss: No comment on the national losses found (Nov 3–10); his victory remarks thanked Arkansans and said he's ready to get back to work.
issues.iran_war: Pre-election: urged Trump to finish the job in Iran. Nov 19: voted no on H.Con.Res. 93, the Iran war powers resolution (Senate roll call 269, rejected 48-51).
issues.ai: Nov 21 (to the Wall Street Journal): faulted Commerce Secretary Lutnick over Nvidia AI chips reaching China through Megaspeed: "If Howard Lutnick wanted my support, perhaps he should have responded to my many letters" (Daily Beast, Nov 21). Congress has much to investigate" (AP).
issues.israel: Pre-election: longtime pro-Israel hawk ("back Israel to the hilt," June 2025).

people.other_themes: As conference chair, received Ron Johnson's letter forcing a debrief meeting. Re-elected conference chair, Nov 10.
people.sources: KY3, Nov 4; CBS News, Nov 10; U.S. Senate roll call 269, Nov 19 (https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS/roll_call_votes/vote1192/vote_119_2_00269.htm); Daily Beast, Nov 21 (https://www.thedailybeast.com/republican-senator-calls-out-top-trump-goon-over-chip-disaster); AP via WLWT, Nov 23 (https://www.wlwt.com/article/congress-huang-reinstatement-lawmakers-hearings/74514264)

people.name: Nikki Haley

issues.midterm_loss: "Not the time to whine"; said Republicans didn't listen to voters. Nov 11 (CNBC): Republicans need to "hear the signs"; "I am not running in 2028."
issues.healthcare: Cited high healthcare costs alongside groceries and gas.
issues.corruption: Said Washington showed self-dealing, corruption and celebrating.
issues.israel: Pre-election (Sept.): demanded Vance "choose a side" between Israel and its critics.

people.sources: NBC Today show; Scripps News, Nov 12 (https://www.scrippsnews.com/politics/america-votes/nikki-haley-rules-out-2028-run-warns-republicans-to-hear-the-signs)

trump_alignment.note: Independent (−1) and now an open critic (−2): calls it self-dealing and corruption.

israel.stance: Strong pro-Israel hawk; pressing Vance to pick a side.

people.name: Ted Cruz

issues.midterm_loss: Called it a Watergate-level repudiation; said Texas is now blue.
issues.trump: Expects Democrats to impeach Trump and Hegseth.
issues.tariffs: Said tariffs have made everything too expensive.
issues.healthcare: Said insurance costs are too high.

economic.note: Was free-market (−1); now attacks tariffs but calls for a blue-collar party, so he moves to center (0).

israel.stance: Strongly pro-Israel; the hawk Vance is positioned against.
